scripts.build:browser: pnpm --filter app exec vite build --config vite.lifecycle.config.ts
scripts.serve:browser: pnpm --filter app exec vite preview --config vite.lifecycle.config.ts --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort
scripts.lint: oxlint app/src app/tests app/*.ts app/*.mjs pipeline/src shared/src
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix app/src app/tests app/*.ts app/*.mjs pipeline/src shared/src
scripts.verify: pnpm fmt:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm --filter pipeline test && pnpm --filter app typecheck && pnpm --filter pipeline typecheck && pnpm build
